Exam Insight

Where IGCSE Marks Vanish

Small habits across Cambridge & Edexcel papers that quietly cost 1 to 3 grade boundaries every year in Abu Dhabi.

Right idea, wrong terminology. Cambridge and Edexcel mark schemes reward specific subject keywords, not vague paraphrases.

Academic Planning

How We Plan the IGCSE Year in Abu Dhabi

A 4-phase structured plan built around the Abu Dhabi school calendar and Cambridge and Edexcel exam timelines.

PHASE 01
Sep to Dec

Diagnostic and Rebuild

A free 30-minute diagnostic spots weak topics and command-word gaps. Lessons rebuild foundations in line with your school's teaching order.

Term 1 Diagnostic
PHASE 02
Jan to Feb

Targeted Mock Fixes

School mock results drive the plan. Lessons pivot directly to high-tariff topics and specific question formats where marks were lost.

Mock Paper Analysis
PHASE 03
Mar to Apr

Weekly Past Papers

Timed practice with real Cambridge and Edexcel past papers. Strict mark scheme grading builds exam technique, speed, and accuracy.

Mark Scheme Mastery
PHASE 04
May to Jun

Final Exam Polish

Final sprint before official board papers. High-frequency formula drills, Paper 6 write-ups, and examiner-style final checks.

Board Exams Ready

Exam Technique

The IGCSE Command Word Decoder

Four exam command words parents can decode in two minutes. Left shows the common misread; right shows what the mark scheme actually rewards.

"State"
Student thinks
Write a fact.
›
Mark scheme rewards
One clear sentence, no context. One mark, one answer, move on.
"Describe"
Student thinks
Write what it looks like.
›
Mark scheme rewards
Observations in order; do not include the reason yet.
"Explain"
Student thinks
Write a lot to be safe.
›
Mark scheme rewards
The reason, cause linked to effect, exact subject terminology.
"Evaluate"
Student thinks
Give an opinion.
›
Mark scheme rewards
Two sides weighed, evidence for each, conclusion in the final line.
